note: Toolbar action buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editor commands (e.g., Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo, Find, Replace, Print, Save, Open, Close, New, Preferences, Help)
Toolbar toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for view modes (e.g., Show Line Numbers, Show Right Margin, Fullscreen, Wrap Mode)
Toolbar status labels -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for document state (e.g., Encoding, Line Ending, or similar static indicators)
View mode radio buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for layout selection (e.g., Normal, Wrap, Word Wrap)
Preferences checkboxes -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editor settings (e.g., Auto Indent, Highlight Syntax, Insert Spaces, Show Line Numbers)
Table column headers -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for data table structure (e.g., Name, Size, Type, Modified)
